text.en: Dog owners highlight the exceptional dedication shown by Heather, Matt, and their training team in Waller. Reviewers appreciate that the trainers take ample time to answer questions, guide owners on handling techniques, and provide supportive coaching. Clients frequently describe the staff as patient, professional, and genuinely invested in each dog's growth.

Clients report dramatic behavioral progress after enrolling their dogs in boarding and training programs. Owners note that unruly or anxious dogs quickly develop solid leash manners, improved impulse control, reliable crate habits, and calmer behavior around distractions. Many pet parents emphasize that the practical foundations established during training make daily life much easier.

title.en: Frequent updates, videos, and owner guidance

text.en: Reviewers consistently praise the team for keeping them informed throughout boarding and training programs. Owners regularly receive photos, progress videos, and detailed explanations showing how their dogs are learning. In addition, clients appreciate that trainers follow up attentively and provide hands-on coaching during pick-up sessions.

q.en: Does All Dogs Training Co. offer board-and-train programs?

a.en: Yes, clients frequently mention enrolling puppies and adolescent dogs in comprehensive multi-week board-and-train courses.

q.en: Do owners receive progress updates while dogs are boarded?

a.en: Yes, reviewers appreciate receiving regular photos, videos, and messages illustrating their pet's milestones.

q.en: Are owners instructed on how to reinforce training at home?

a.en: Yes, trainers provide hands-on lessons during pickups to ensure owners understand how to maintain newly learned behaviors.
